text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Why... rough skin, of all things...? No, it cannot be.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Both my health and nutrition management
were supposed to be flawless, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In any case... it seems I'll need to
re-evaluate my lifestyle from scratch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Ikuno Dictus was unable to hide her bewilderment at her sudden skin breakout.
